item.title: Critical Care Management of Disaster-Related Organ Failure.
item.description: Disasters generate high volumes of multisystem trauma while simultaneously degrading the staff, equipment, and electricity that critical care depends on. This article reviews management of disaster-related organ failure under resource constraint. item.title: Resuscitation of the Trauma Patient.
item.description: This article provides a practical overview of modern trauma resuscitation for emergency clinicians. It emphasizes early recognition of shock, timely hemorrhage control, and activation of massive transfusion protocols. Guidance is provided on fluid resuscitation, permissive hypotension, airway management, and treatment of agitation in critically ill trauma patients. item.description: Literature on the quality of death and dying has predominantly drawn on high-income contexts, while much less is known about end-of-life care in low-middle-income settings. In Vietnam, policy and practice around palliative and end-of-life care has not kept pace with the ageing of the population. item.title: Bedside ECMO Cannulation by Intensivists and Emergency Physicians.
item.description: The number of centers capable of initiating extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) for critically ill patients with refractory cardiac or respiratory failure is expanding.
